svg.title: Tilta Position Code
svg.desc: Byte-by-byte layout of the 16-byte frame the Tilta handle and the H2 bridge send: a length byte, a 9-byte IEEE 802.15.4 header (frame control 61 88, sequence number, PAN 0x01E7, broadcast destination, source 0xF096), a 4-byte Tilta payload and the radio's 2-byte CRC. The payload holds the packet type (4 = position), a 12-bit position from 0 to 4095, a direction bit (1 = falling), a 7-bit speed of about 180 counts/s per unit, and a checksum that makes the four payload bytes sum to 00. Example: 4A 9C 8A 90 is position 2716, falling at speed 10.
svg.text: One IEEE 802.15.4 data frame per position update. Example: the handle turning toward 0, at 2716 with speed 10.
Header fields are little-endian (E7 01 = PAN 0x01E7). The motor acknowledges every packet with ACK 02 00 C4, the same sequence number.
Bit 7 and the speed were measured on the Nucleus-N II Control Handle; strawlab's Knob capture has 00 in byte 12.
